open_findings: src/types/database.types.ts is stale relative to migration 20260316031209 - it lists 11 tables and omits claude_bot_config. Harmless (the table is service_role only and never read from the client) but the next `supabase gen types` run will add it.

The v1->v2 IndexedDB photos migration is now destructive: upgradeDb() drops and recreates the photos store, and the data-preserving path that lived in photoStorageService._doInit() was deleted with that file. Acceptable because photos are Supabase-first, but the comment in dbSchema.ts still references photoStorageService and is stale.

photosSlice.updatePhoto() accepts Partial<SupabasePhoto> and optimistically merges any field into local state, but photoService.updatePhoto() persists only `caption`. Tag edits appear to succeed until reload.

The Fart button in PokeKissInterface.tsx is a client-only animation with no store action, service call, or DB representation (the interaction_type enum is ('poke','kiss') only). Documented as such rather than removed.
